asset.name: Popover
asset.description: The collision-aware anchored surface with focus management, pointer-safe interaction corridors, arrow positioning, nested layering, and a responsive fallback presentation.

requires.reason: Sizing, spacing, radius, and layer order resolve to declared ramps.
Background and elevation come from the shared surface primitive rather than per-overlay shadow values.
Enter and exit lifecycle, interruption, and reduced-motion collapse are owned once.
Dismissal understands pointer, focus, nested layers, and portals.
Escape closes only the topmost eligible surface.
Open state uses the shared controlled and uncontrolled contract.

rationale: The anchoring base for tooltip, menu, select, and hover card. Its pointer-safe corridor is the detail that separates a usable submenu from one that closes while you move toward it diagonally.
